faq_heading: Abbotsford houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Abbotsford house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 90 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $1,195,000, with the middle half between $1,056,625 and $1,320,000. Every Abbotsford detached house had a median of $1,050,250.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Abbotsford?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 90 Abbotsford houses sold with a legal suite and 134 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,080,000.

faq.q: What size can an Abbotsford secondary suite be?
faq.a: Less than 50% of the principal unit. That replaced a 100 square metre cap, and one suite is allowed in each single detached dwelling.

faq.q: What lot tests does an Abbotsford suite have to meet?
faq.a: Council reports describe a lot of at least 400 square metres, frontage of at least 12.0 metres, a Collector or Local road, and a lot that is not on a cul-de-sac bulb.

faq.q: Which Abbotsford neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Abbotsford West had 38 legal-suite sales, Abbotsford East 36 and Central Abbotsford 8 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Abbotsford houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 28 days at a median, closing at 96.9% of list, with 6% over the list price.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed sales to August 31, 2026, because the export is incomplete after that. The live search is not connected yet.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Abbotsford that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Abbotsford East (257), Abbotsford West (114), Central Abbotsford (73), Aberdeen (26) and Poplar (17). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 498 detached houses that closed in Abbotsford between November 1 and August 31, 224 (45%) had a suite: 90 legal and 134 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $1,195,000, 14% more than the $1,050,250 median for every Abbotsford house.

blocks.text: The typical legal-suite house sits on 6,534 sq ft, against 7,193 sq ft for all Abbotsford houses. It has 3,000 square feet of floor area, against 2,662. 98% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 49% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 2,926 square feet and a median $1,080,000.

Alongside suites, 10 Abbotsford houses had lane access, at a median of $1,038,750; 4 were marked as a coach or laneway house. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: Abbotsford’s Zoning Bylaw No. 2400-2014, section 140.3.8, allows one secondary suite in every single detached dwelling. A suite has to be under 50% of the principal unit’s size, a rule that replaced an older 100 square metre cap.

Council reports describe the lot tests a suite must meet: at least 400 square metres of lot, at least 12.0 metres of frontage, a Collector or Local road, and not a cul-de-sac bulb. A listing can call a suite legal on a lot that fails one of these, so check the lot with the City as well as the house.

A coach house or garden suite is a separate rule. Abbotsford lets one cover up to 15% of the lot, to a maximum of 100 square metres, and that figure belongs to Abbotsford alone. The City adopted its small-scale multi-unit changes in June 2024.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Abbotsford was $1,087,000 in September 2026, 11.1% down over twelve months. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Before you offer on a Abbotsford house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Abbotsford permit and final inspection for the suite. 134 of the 224 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.

Ask whether the lot meets the City’s suite tests (400 square metres, 12.0 metres of frontage, a Collector or Local road, not a cul-de-sac bulb). A suite that was permitted on a lot that no longer meets them is worth a call to the City.
Measure the suite against the limit of 50% of the principal unit. On the median Abbotsford legal-suite house of 3,000 square feet, 50% comes to about 1,500 square feet.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 28 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,080,000 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $1,195,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
